# Channel settings

<!-- Generated by app/dev/gen_settings_docs.py from the bot's variable definitions. Do not edit by hand. -->

Channel settings apply to one Discord channel and every queue on it. Change them in the web panel
(select the channel, then **Settings**), with `/channel set <variable> <value>`, or all at once with
`!set_channel_cfg <json>`. Members need the channel's **Admin role** (or *Edit channel settings* in the
web panel) to change them.

Durations are written like `1h 30m`, `45m` or `00:15:00`. Roles and channels are picked from a list in the web panel; in chat use a mention or the name.

## General

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Command prefix | `prefix` | text | `!` | Set the prefix before for the bot`s commands |
| Language | `lang` | choice | `en` | Select bot translation language Options: `en`. |
| Admin role | `admin_role` | role | not set | Members with this role will be able to change the bot`s settings and use moderation commands. |
| Moderator role | `moderator_role` | role | not set | Members with this role will be able to use the bot`s moderation commands. |
| Promotion role | `promotion_role` | role | not set | Set a role to highlight on !promote and !sub commands. |
| Promotion delay | `promotion_delay` | duration | not set | Set time delay between players can promote queues. |
| Blacklist role | `blacklist_role` | role | not set | Players with this role wont be able to add to queues. |
| Whitelist role | `whitelist_role` | role | not set | If set, only players with this role will be able to add to queues. |
| Auto ready limit | `max_auto_ready` | duration | `00:15:00` | Set limit on how long !auto_ready duration can be. Disable to prohibit the command. |
| Description | `description` | multi-line text | not set | Set an answer on '!help' command. |
| Auto-refresh queue panel | `panel_autorefresh` | number | not set | Every this many minutes, re-post the queue panel at the bottom of the channel if chat has pushed it up. Not set = off. |

## Auto-remove

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Auto remove on AFK status | `remove_afk` | on / off | `on` |  |
| Auto remove on offline status | `remove_offline` | on / off | `on` |  |
| Auto remove on timer after last !add command | `expire_time` | duration | not set |  |

## Messages

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Match start message | `match_embed_style` | choice | `modern` | Layout of the message posted when a match starts:<br>modern - FragQ layout: teams side by side, numbered maps, tidy server list<br>classic - the original PUBobot2 layout |
| Ping players on match start | `match_ping` | on / off | `on` | Mention the players above the match message. Mentions inside an embed don't notify anyone (modern layout only). |
| Keep queue panel at the bottom | `panel_repost` | on / off | `on` | Re-post the queue panel (Join/Leave buttons) below the match message whenever a match starts, so it doesn't get buried. |
| Moderator buttons on queue panel | `panel_mod_buttons` | on / off | `on` | Show Add Player and Pause Queue on the queue panel. Everyone can see them, only the moderator and admin roles can use them. |

## Rating

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rating system | `rating_system` | choice | `TrueSkill` | Set player's rating calculation method. Options: `flat`, `Glicko2`, `TrueSkill`. |
| Rating host channel | `rating_channel` | channel | not set | Use rating data from another channel. |
| Initial rating | `rating_initial` | number | `1500` | Set player's initial rating. |
| Initial deviation | `rating_deviation` | number | `200` | Set player's initial rating deviation. |
| Minimum deviation | `rating_min_deviation` | number | `75` | Set players minimum deviation value. If not set, rating changes may seek to 0 over time. |
| Rating scale | `rating_scale` | percent | not set | Scale all rating changes, 100% = x1. |
| Rating loss scale | `rating_loss_scale` | percent | not set | Scale rating changes for losses, 100% = x1.<br>Warning: changing this will break ratings balance. |
| Rating win scale | `rating_win_scale` | percent | not set | Scale rating changes for wins, 100% = x1.<br>Warning: changing this will break ratings balance. |
| Rating draw bonus | `rating_draw_bonus` | percent | not set | Add rating bonus for draws.<br>100% = x + 1x // -100% = x - 1x<br>Warning: changing this will break ratings balance. |
| Rating winning streak boost | `rating_ws_boost` | on / off | `off` | Apply rating boost from 1.5x to 3x from 3 to 6 won matches in a row. |
| Rating losing streak boost | `rating_ls_boost` | on / off | `off` | Apply rating boost from 1.5x to 3x from 3 to 6 lost matches in a row. |
| Rating decay | `rating_decay` | number | `15` | Set weekly rating decay until a nearest rank is met. Applies only to inactive players. |
| Rating deviation decay | `rating_deviation_decay` | number | `15` | Set weekly rating deviation decay until initial deviation is met. Applies to all players. |

## Leaderboard

| Setting | Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leaderboard min matches | `lb_min_matches` | number | not set | Set a minimum amount of played matches required for a player to be shown in the !leaderboard. |
| Leaderboard last match limit | `lb_last_match_limit` | duration | not set | Hide players from the leaderboard that hasn't played a single match for specified duration. |
| Set ratings to nicks | `rating_nicks` | on / off | `off` | Add [rating] prefix to guild members nicknames. |
| Ranks are emojis | `emoji_ranks` | on / off | `off` | Display rank strings like emojis. |
| Rating ranks | `ranks` | table | 8 rows |  |

**Rating ranks** (`ranks`) is a table with the columns `rank`, `rating`, `role`.

| rank | rating | role |

| 〈G〉 | 0 | – |
| 〈F〉 | 1000 | – |
| 〈E〉 | 1200 | – |
| 〈D〉 | 1400 | – |

| 〈A〉 | 1900 | – |
| 〈★〉 | 2000 | – |
